description: Project release discovery contract: eight read-only capabilities and two explicitly non-read-only execution capabilities. This does not ratify or replace the public interoperability proposal.

requiredTools.name: sap.system.list
requiredTools.capability: List configured SAP system identities without returning credentials.

requiredTools.name: sap.system.inspect
requiredTools.capability: Inspect bounded metadata for one selected SAP system.

requiredTools.name: sap.repository.search
requiredTools.capability: Search the ABAP repository with bounded results.

requiredTools.name: sap.source.read
requiredTools.capability: Read exact ABAP source by object identity or canonical resource URI.

requiredTools.name: sap.quality.atc.run
requiredTools.capability: Run and normalize ABAP Test Cockpit findings.

requiredTools.name: sap.transport.inspect
requiredTools.capability: Inspect a transport and its bounded object metadata.

requiredTools.name: sap.rap.availability
requiredTools.capability: Report RAP generator availability without generating artifacts.

requiredResources.name: sap-capability-evidence
requiredResources.purpose: Per-system evidence that separates implementation, discovery, authorization, and live verification.

requiredResources.name: sap-evidence
requiredResources.purpose: Bounded follow-up artifacts produced by tools during the current server run.

requiredExecutionTools.name: sap.quality.unit_test
requiredExecutionTools.capability: Run and normalize ABAP Unit results.

requiredExecutionTools.name: sap.transport.assess
requiredExecutionTools.capability: Assess a transport without releasing it and return machine-readable evidence.
